description: This file defines the DateFormatter class in Drupal, providing date formatting and interval calculation functionalities, including handling timezones, date formats, and date differences.

classes.name: DateFormatter
classes.description: A service class in Drupal for formatting dates, intervals, and handling date formats with support for timezones and localization.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a date string based on specified type, format, timezone, and language.

methods.name: formatInterval
methods.description: Formats a time interval into a human-readable string with specified granularity and language.

methods.name: getSampleDateFormats
methods.description: Generates sample date strings for all date format characters in the current locale.

methods.name: formatTimeDiffUntil
methods.description: Formats the time difference from now until a given timestamp.

methods.name: formatTimeDiffSince
methods.description: Formats the time difference from a given timestamp until now.

methods.name: formatDiff
methods.description: Calculates and formats the difference between two timestamps into a human-readable string or object.

methods.name: dateFormat
methods.description: Loads and caches a date format pattern for a given type and language.
